exposure: medical factors (pre-eclampsia, eclampsia, gestational diabetes mellitus, anemia, HIV)
obstetric factors (placenta previa, placental abruption, preterm delivery, multiparity)
cohort: The cohort consisted of 214 women with stillbirths and 428 women with live births at more than 28 weeks of gestation, recruited from four hospitals.
finding: Stillbirth was significantly associated with pre-eclampsia, eclampsia, placenta previa, placental abruption, preterm delivery, and gestational diabetes mellitus.
